meta.imbalance_condition: none (D4 reference condition; E4a varies this)

data_rules.note: the overlap rule protects evaluation on the official test set, which E2 does not use; leaving it off keeps the pool identical to the E1 baseline pool and preserves thin-class instances

meta.grid_deviation: lora_r is FIXED at 16 rather than swept, decided against the completed encoder arm (matrix v1.10, THESIS_LOG #100d); the epoch axis is a ceiling of 8 closed by early stopping at patience 2, not a fixed cap. 2 grid cells on lr.
meta.seed_semantics: the partition is fixed at the primary seed; the seed varies training, and replicates run on one fold only (D3)

notes: peaked at epoch 1 then fell (0.8287 -> 0.7774): overfits within one pass. lr or lora_r is too high.

stopping_evidence.verdict: 10 of 10 fits stopped early, 4 on a rising trace, 0 were still improving at the ceiling
